gcm.purpose: Keep Morning Command Source Email readable by removing flattened Gmail link-formatting debris without sender-specific rules.
changeNotes: Updates the Morning Command Gmail decision surface to 2.0.2.
Removes angle-bracket URL wrappers and flattened href attributes while preserving ordinary evidence URLs and visible message text.
Extends the permanent Gmail Source Email display regression while preserving the human-routing, Monitoring, Investigation, Requested Work, Information, and Delete boundaries.
